aenain: Created by great power from mystical forces, Genies are creatures of magic; Aenain was made imperfect. For centuries he has worked to overcome the perception of his imperfection. His diligence and dedication to Air Magic earned him a call to the Conflux.
ciele: Ciele grew up beside the ocean bordering Avlee and always felt a bond with its ancient waters. She wandered the lands seeking her calling; at last, her search brought her into the service of the Conflux.
inteus: Inteus mastered fire at an early age and earned a place in a troupe of entertainers. Some believed he was the son of a Fire Elemental. One night, he felt a calling and left his profession; he now serves the Conflux.
labetha: Labetha was born poor, and her peasant parents were slaughtered during the Restoration wars. Dendroids took her into their service in AvLee, where her power over earth developed quickly. When the Conflux called, she answered just as quickly.
luna: Once a sorceress in Enroth, Luna felt the call of the elemental Conflux and made her way to Erathia. There she was compelled to set aside her aquatic talents and turn her efforts toward developing fire magic.
